scope: Executable named-variable/SN:W adapter prerequisite; does not admit full AC/ERA/Reborn profiles

sources.rule: NewStrictAssocArr calls NewAssocArr with SysUtils.AnsiLowerCase. Existing equal key updates only Value, retaining original key spelling.

Named integer and string variables share AdvErm.AssocMem[name], with distinct IntValue and StrValue fields. Missing reads return zero or empty without creating a cell. Names containing percent markers interpolate.

SN:W shares named i/s memory. Arity0 clears,1deletes whole pair,2queries/mutates typed field. Save writes name/int/string; reload discards zero-and-empty pairs. d| applies bitwise AND in actual source despite MODIFIER_OR name.

keyPolicy.implemented: ASCII case-insensitive identity, original first spelling preserved; no numeric v/z aliasing
keyPolicy.nonAscii: Explicit runtime rejection until original Windows ANSI codepage is attested; no host-locale tolower substitution
keyPolicy.dynamicNames: Dynamic interpolation may produce non-ASCII keys; these also fail explicitly.

implemented: i^name^ and s^name^ operands, including indexed numeric indirection
Dynamic names using existing source interpolation plus %I(name) and %S(name)
SN:W read/write/delete/clear, numeric modifiers + - * : % | ~ << >>, string concatenation d&
Saved associative fields, missing-field old-save compatibility, case-equivalent duplicate rejection, native zero/empty reload behavior
Native executor control flow and suspend/save/resume retain named state without replay
remaining: Modern VA/DC/local symbolic variables and named event/function aliases are not yet implemented by this adapter.
Native SN:E/code patch hooks remain unbound and fail; this adapter never no-ops them.
Numeric evaluation of a named string as an ERA temporary address/index is not implemented and fails explicitly.
Full AC/ERA/Reborn gameplay, AI and UI closure remains pending.
